answer: A circadian-activity gate scores the timing of each wallet's work. Genuine graders leave an inlet of quiet hours while they sleep; their posts cluster in waking stretches. A sybil farm's bots post on a flat gale of around-the-clock output with no night, which the ledger flags and downweights. To pass, an attacker must fake N separate believable sleep rhythms, parking each clone on a ledge of rest that fits no shared script. Cost is N human-like schedules, not one tireless loop.
